agents.leaseWhat: A claim in Building that nobody has heard from for longer than this can go back to Ready: the card says quiet, the task pane offers Release, and muster reclaim takes it.

agents.modelMeta: The model the helper files tasks with, from its next message: Sonnet unless you pick another. Haiku is quicker and costs less; Opus thinks hardest and costs most.

account.which: Which Claude account should the helper use?
account.meta: The helper runs your own Claude Code with that account's own login, like any session you start, and never reads tokens. What you write here goes to Anthropic, the same as any Claude Code session. You can change it any time.

roles.head: Roles
roles.meta: Who the team is: each role's name, and its slots (Kaveh-1, Kaveh-2) for sessions that claim with --role. A rename shows everywhere at once: claims keep the role and the number, not the name. Saved in roles.toml beside projects.json; muster team lists who holds which slot.

models.label: Models

providers.label: Providers
providers.what: Who may serve it: claude, codex.

slots.label: Slots
slots.what: How many may run at once, 1 to 20; --role hands out the lowest free one.

max_turns.label: Turn cap
max_turns.what: Turns a run may take, 1 to 1000.

context_cap.label: Context cap
context_cap.what: Tokens of context before it hands off, 10000 to 1000000.

notifications.what: One notification when something new waits for you: a task in Your check, a question escalated to you, a task blocked on you or by a permission, a session that waits for your input in Claude Code, a task of your own, or lessons to approve. Several at once come as one.
notifications.once: It's never twice for the same thing, and not for what was already waiting when Muster started. While Muster's window is in front, what it shows (its project, or All) counts as seen, and news from another project waits until you switch away.
notifications.macos: macOS asks whether Muster may notify the first time it has something to tell you; change that later in System Settings › Notifications. Nothing leaves this Mac.
notifications.icon: Muster's robot head in the menu bar, plain while nothing waits for you and with its antenna tips filled in when something does: the same count as the Dock badge, from the same reads. Its tooltip and menu say the count in words, never a task's text.
notifications.click: Click it to bring Muster's window forward. Right-click or Control-click it for Show Muster, the count and Quit Muster.
notifications.saved: Both are saved on this Mac, in <path/>, with what it won't notify again beside it.

projects.finds: Muster finds the queues in {{base}} on its own: a repo's {{repo}} ({{under}} or {{deeper}}) and the older {{older}}, one level deeper too ({{olderDeeper}}). Add queues kept anywhere else, or start one: New queue picks the project's repo (its main checkout or any worktree of it) and makes a local {{local}} in the main checkout, as {{init}} does. A folder outside any repo still gets the older {{tasks}}. Removing or hiding a project never deletes files.

focus.label: Focus
